entities.name: Otto Königsberger
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Otto H. Königsberger was a German-Indian architect who worked mainly in urban development planning in Africa, Asia and Latin America, with the United Nations. He also proposed plans for developing new cities like Bhubaneswar and Jamshedpur in India.
